meta.name: A Word for Today
meta.description: Press a button and it says one thing back. That is all it does

msg.hello:
Good to see you.
**How are you doing today?**
msg.futsu: Ordinary days are the ones you can keep having.
msg.tsukare: Fair enough. This is far enough for today.

cal.genki: While you are here, look at **just one page** you have been wondering about. Tomorrow's you will be glad.
cal.futsu: On an ordinary day, the trick is **not to start anything new**.
